result.title: Fault-tolerant shallow recurrent decoders for sparse sensing with missing sensor measurements
result.summary: Real-world sensing systems are inherently imperfect: sensors may fail, intermittently disconnect, operate with asynchronous sampling rates, and be subject to noise, leading to measurement streams that are irregular, incomplete, and heterogeneous. Nevertheless, sensing strategies for real-time state reconstruction typically assume synchronous and continuously active sensors, a constraint that substantially limits their applicability in operational environments. In this work, we introduce fault-tolerant sparse sensing strategies in the context of shallow recurrent decoders (SHRED) to enable high-dimensional state estimation from sparse, asynchronous, and missing sensor measurements. Specifically, we consider naive imputation strategies, fault-tolerant recurrent temporal encoders, and we introduce four different transformer-based masking mechanisms to make SHRED explicitly aware of sensor availability through the binary data-availability mask. Moreover, we further introduce a multi-step decoding training objective for SHRED, resulting in smoother latent trajectories and more robust predictions. Throughout a synthetic benchmark and three real-world problems in hydrodynamic and ocean modeling, we show that (i) transformer-based masking mechanisms outperform standard imputation techniques and fault-tolerant recurrent architectures, (ii) the multi-step decoding training objective enhances reconstruction fidelity and robustness in the presence of heterogeneous missing-data patterns, while (iii) the computational efficiency of SHRED is preserved, with no additional inference-time overhead.

AI.brief_summary: 针对稀疏、异步且常缺失的传感器测量，论文在浅层循环解码器 SHRED 中引入容错稀疏感知策略：比较朴素插补与容错循环时间编码器，提出四种基于 Transformer 的掩码机制显式利用数据可用性掩码，并加入多步解码训练目标，在水动力学与海洋建模任务上验证重建鲁棒性与推理效率。
AI.relevance_reason: 用二元可用性掩码显式告知模型哪些证据缺失，并以多步解码训练获得更平滑的 latent 轨迹，这些做法可供核查 VLM latent 推理中视觉证据筛选、状态更新与轨迹监督的设计。
